info.title: TutorHub API
info.description: Backend REST API for TutorHub Tutor Matching Platform

get.summary: Get paginated list of tutor applications with status and search filters (Admin only).

post.summary: Approve a pending tutor application (Admin only).
Reject a tutor application with a reason (Admin only).

get.summary: Get paginated list of tutor profiles with status and search filters (Admin only).
Get paginated list of all withdrawal requests in the platform (Admin only).
Get withdrawal details by ID (Admin only).

post.summary: Mark a pending withdrawal request as Processing (Admin only).
Complete a processing withdrawal request and finalize payout (Admin only).
Mark a processing withdrawal as Failed and atomically restore amount to tutor's available balance (Admin only).

get.summary: Get paginated list of all dispute reports with status filter (Admin only).
Get full detail of a dispute report by ID (Admin only).

post.summary: Resolve a dispute report with decision and optional financial refund (Admin only).

get.summary: Get paginated list of all categories with active filter and search (Admin only).

post.summary: Create a new category (Admin only).

delete.summary: Delete a category (Admin only - must contain no subjects).

get.summary: Get paginated list of all subjects with category, active, and search filters (Admin only).

post.summary: Create a new subject within an active category (Admin only).

delete.summary: Delete a subject (Admin only - must not be associated with tutors or bookings).

get.summary: Get real-time overview metrics for the Admin Dashboard (Admin only).
Get monthly revenue and booking analytics chart data (Admin only).
Get paginated list of all users on the platform with search and filters (Admin only).
Get detailed profile, teaching/learning stats, and recent bookings for a specific user (Admin only).

post.summary: Suspend a user account with session revocation and audit logging (Admin only).
Reactivate a suspended user account with audit logging (Admin only).
Ban a user account with session revocation and audit logging (Admin only).

get.summary: Get paginated list of all financial transactions across the platform with filters (Admin only).

post.summary: Force unpublish a violating service offering from the platform (Admin only).

Administrative emergency cancellation of an active learning contract (Admin only).
Uncompleted sessions are cancelled and refunded from Escrow. Completed sessions are preserved.

delete.summary: Moderate and remove a violating review from the platform (Admin only).

get.summary: Admin: Inspect conversations with operational access reason (DEC-S7-016).
Admin: Inspect messages in a conversation with operational access reason (DEC-S7-016).
Admin: Query immutable central audit logs with comprehensive filters.
Admin: List disputes with optional status filter and pagination.
Admin: Get 360-degree investigation packet for a dispute.

post.summary: Admin: Transition dispute to UnderReview.
Admin: Terminal resolution with financial settlement and explicit ledger adjustments.
Admin: Fast-track template resolution for one-sided-silence disputes (pre-release escrow only).
Admin: Process external settlement callback for student refund.

get.summary: Admin: List platform settings with version history.

put.summary: Admin: Update the platform fee rate (monotonically versioned, immutable snapshot on future enrollments).

Admin: Upsert a generic versioned platform policy (F-17 plumbing).
Allowed keys: VerificationWindowHours, ReviewWindowDays, CancellationPolicy,
RefundRules, WithdrawalRules. Values stay opaque until D-01..D-08 decide semantics.

get.summary: Admin: Platform revenue analytics with net dispute fee reconciliation.
Admin: List Trust & Safety reports with optional status filter (FR-TRUST-003).
Admin: Get Trust & Safety report detail by ID (FR-TRUST-003).

post.summary: Admin: Enforce Trust & Safety moderation action on a report (FR-TRUST-004: Warn, Suspend, Ban, RemoveContent, Dismiss).
Propose a new custom agreement offer to a student (Tutor only - FR-AGREE-001).

get.summary: Get custom agreement details by ID (Participant student/tutor or Admin - FR-AGREE-003).
Get paginated list of custom agreements for the current authenticated user.

post.summary: Accept a proposed custom agreement offer (Designated Student only - FR-AGREE-003).
Reject a proposed custom agreement offer (Designated Student only).
Cancel/withdraw a proposed custom agreement offer (Proposing Tutor only).
Checkout an accepted custom agreement into a canonical 15-minute holding Booking ready for payment (Designated Student only - FR-AGREE-004).
Register a new student or tutor account.
Log in with email and password.
Refresh an expired access token using a valid refresh token (Rotation enabled).
Log out and revoke the specified refresh token.
Change the current user's password and revoke active sessions.

get.summary: Get information about the currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Create a new service package booking with a 15-minute temporary checkout hold (Student only).

get.summary: Get paginated list of bookings for the authenticated user (Student/Tutor only).
Get detailed booking information by ID (Participant or Admin only).

post.summary: Cancel a booking and process refund according to PRD cancellation policy (Student/Tutor).

get.summary: Get list of active categories with their active nested subjects (Public).
Get details of an active category by ID with its active subjects (Public).

post.summary: Get or create a 1-to-1 conversation with target user.

get.summary: Get my conversations list with keyset cursor pagination.
Get messages in a conversation with keyset cursor pagination.

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation.
Upload an attachment file for a conversation message.

get.summary: Download/access an attachment file for a conversation message.

put.summary: Mark all unread incoming messages in a conversation as read.

post.summary:
Dispatches a signed VNPay IPN for a holding booking as if the gateway had just
confirmed (or declined) the payment.
File a dispute on a scheduled or completed session.
Upload supporting evidence for an active dispute.

get.summary: Get disputes involving the current user as initiator or respondent.
Get paginated list of learning contracts (enrollments) for the authenticated Student or Tutor.
Get detailed learning contract information including all sessions by ID (Participants or Admin).

post.summary:
Student requests cancellation of an active learning contract.
Uncompleted sessions are cancelled and refunded from Escrow. Completed sessions are preserved.

Tutor declares inability to continue teaching the learning contract.
Uncompleted sessions are cancelled and refunded from Escrow. Completed sessions are preserved.
Generate a Presigned PUT URL for Frontend to upload binary directly to Cloudflare R2.
Confirm direct upload completion: Verifies file existence on R2 (HEAD check) and persists metadata record in Database.
Direct API stream upload to Cloudflare R2 with Magic Bytes binary validation (convenient for small files / avatars).

get.summary: Get fresh Presigned Download URL for a media file (15-minute validity after ownership check).

delete.summary: Soft delete media record in database and delete physical object from Cloudflare R2 storage.

post.summary: Generate a secured VNPay Sandbox Payment URL for a holding booking (Student only).

get.summary: VNPay browser return URL redirect handler (Presentation / Read-Only).
VNPay Server-to-Server Instant Payment Notification (IPN) Webhook (Atomic and Idempotent Mutation).

post.summary:
Submit a conduct or policy violation report for a booking (Booking participant only).
Note: For financial or session issues, please submit a formal dispute via POST /api/v1/disputes.

get.summary: Get paginated list of dispute reports submitted by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Submit a review for a completed enrollment (Student only).

get.summary: Get the review for a specific enrollment (Student owner, Tutor owner, or Admin).

post.summary: Tutor replies to a student review (Tutor owner only).
Report a review for policy violation (Authenticated users).
Initial scheduling for an unscheduled session (Student or Tutor participant).

Dual attendance verification (Student or Tutor participant).
Matching attendance automatically completes session and releases progressive escrow payout.

get.summary: Get calendar view of sessions for the current user within an optional intersection date range.

post.summary:
Propose a reschedule for an agreed scheduled session (Tutor only - FR-SESSION-004).
Does not mutate the session schedule until accepted by the Student.

get.summary: Get reschedule proposal history for a session (Student or Tutor participant).

post.summary:
Accept a pending reschedule proposal (Student only - FR-SESSION-005).
Atomically updates session schedule, emits outbox event, and records permanent audit log.

Reject a pending reschedule proposal (Student only - FR-SESSION-005).
Marks the proposal as rejected while leaving the session schedule untouched.

Cancel a single session (Student or Tutor participant, F-19 gate, no finance).
Only Unscheduled or future Scheduled sessions. Escrow stays held; the existing
enrollment pro-rata formula absorbs the amount on complete/cancel.
Write the learning record for a completed session (Tutor only, F-14, write-once).

get.summary: Get the learning record of a session (Student or Tutor participant, read-only).
Get paginated list of active subjects with optional category and search filters (Public).
Get details of an active subject by ID (Public).
Get personal transaction history for the authenticated student or tutor.
Search and filter verified tutors with pagination (Public).
Get public profile details of a tutor by ID (Public).

Get dynamic availability schedule of a tutor by ID across a specific date range (Public).
Calculates open time ranges by subtracting active bookings.
Get paginated public reviews for a specific tutor (Public).

post.summary: Submit a new tutor application for admin review (Tutor only).

get.summary: Get the current tutor application status and details (Tutor only).

post.summary:
Resubmit a tutor application after rejection (Tutor only, F-18).
Creates a new Pending application; blocked while Pending or Approved.

get.summary: Get the profile details of the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

patch.summary:
Partially update the profile information of the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).
Only non-null provided fields will be updated.

put.summary: Update the registered subjects for the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

get.summary: Get weekly availability slots of the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

post.summary: Create a new weekly availability slot for the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

delete.summary: Delete a weekly availability slot by ID for the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

put.summary:
Atomically synchronize the tutor's entire weekly recurring availability schedule (Tutor only - INV-AVAIL-006).
Fails fast with 409 Conflict if any future scheduled session would be left uncovered.

post.summary: Create a new tutoring service offering (Tutor only). Created in Draft status.

get.summary: Get all service offerings owned by the authenticated tutor across all statuses (Tutor only).
Get details of a specific service offering owned by the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

patch.summary:
Update a service offering owned by the authenticated tutor (Tutor only).
For published services, commercial terms cannot be modified directly (unpublish first).

post.summary: Publish a draft or unpublished service to make it publicly discoverable on the marketplace (Tutor only).
Unpublish an active service to hide it from the public marketplace (Tutor only).

get.summary: Get all published service offerings of a specific tutor (Public).
Get the complete profile information of the currently authenticated user.

put.summary: Update personal profile information (FullName, Phone, AvatarUrl) for the currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Report another user for conduct, harassment, or platform violations (FR-TRUST-001).

get.summary: Get wallet balance and overview (Tutor only).

post.summary: Submit a new withdrawal request to payout bank account (Tutor only).

get.summary: Get paginated withdrawal history for authenticated tutor (Tutor only).
Get default payout bank account destination for authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

put.summary: Update default payout bank account destination for authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

get.summary: Get paginated financial ledger statement for authenticated tutor (Tutor only).

Bearer.description: Nhập JWT Access Token của bạn vào đây (Swagger sẽ tự động đính kèm 'Bearer ' phía trước).
